wiki.title: Kristin Dassler-Alfheim
wiki.extract: Kristin M. Dassler-Alfheim (née Dassler; born August 1971) is an American businesswoman and politician from Appleton, Wisconsin. She is a member of the Wisconsin Senate, representing Wisconsin's 18th Senate district since 2025. She previously served four years as a member of the Appleton Common Council. A political independent for most of her life, she is now a member of the Democratic Party.
